t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnome appears in pairs of colours, each colour leads to the bright and dark forest, recognizing which colour leads to what forest is important to the success of the game regardless of the size or position of the gnome, it is imperative to focus on taking note of the colours.

vb_textbox.text: Hello, please read through my advice carefully, it will aid you in the game. In the game you will be presented with 2 gnomes with different colour pair: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple, though, the positions of the gnome may vary but their colour always appear same way.Each colour will lead you to either bright or dark forest, specifically, the orange, red, green, blue gnomes leads to bright forest while the brown, pink, yellow and purple leads to the dark forest.Try as much to study the colour that leads to the forest with most mushrooms, though, the number of mushrooms changes but the colours will guide you on your decision making.Do not worry about the point multiplier, just try to know which gnome colour guides to forest with most mushrooms.Goodluck!
